### TC.Config.Read.LuaRailSignalBaseControlBehavior.blue_signal

Blue color-component input for lamps, or blue-state output for chain signals. Unknown fields refused. rail_chain_signal_only: Available only on chain signals; ordinary rail signals cannot read/write it. Explicit root patch clear: accepted with native reset/readback.
